class.name: IfcCompressor
class.brief_description: A compressor is a device that compresses a fluid typically used in a refrigeration circuit. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcCompressor defines the occurrence of any compressor; common information about compressor types is handled by IfcCompressorType .
